description: This source file defines the class OrderValueList, which implements the <order-value-list> element in the MiniLang framework of Apache OFBiz. It provides functionality to order a list of entities based on specified order-by criteria and supports configuration via XML element attributes. It also includes a nested factory class for creating instances of OrderValueList.
